other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
Family must be living Below Poverty Line (BPL).
Primary breadwinner of the family must be deceased.
Deceased breadwinner's age must have been more than 18 years and less than 60 years.
Applicant must be the succeeding primary breadwinner (head of household) of the family.
benefits_summary: A lump‑sum assistance of ₹20,000 is paid to the surviving head of household after the death of the primary breadwinner.
